items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Valto, that's all I know is Valto.

ctx.x: That's the old Creole. Yeah, Narm used to play with him. Well? To say across the river too, Ullett, across the river. No, no, he's not. No, Ullett. Well the old man Ullett, I played with him, with, uh, in Bucktown. Yeah. With the old man Ullett. He's the old Creole man. Yeah. But he had, and this cantrip used to play, uh, uh, uh, ghetto. Cantrip. He used to have, uh, well you don't know him, then. He used to have, uh, you know he gets little spells sometimes. Oh yeah, the shaky spells. Yeah, the shaky spells. He…

Well, there's another violin player I wanted to ask about, Valto, they call him. Valto, well, Valto, he died. I think Valto died. Was he from this side or the other side? He lived on this side, Valto.
